decisions.reason: As a software product close to the core offer and clearly tied to the firm's publicly stated move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure, it has enough strategic fit and visible prior commitment to justify continued support.

This hardware accessory sits farther from the firm's announced digital direction and, after disappearing quickly from the website, carries too little visible commitment to sustain escalation despite the initial launch effort.

Even though its standalone web visibility faded early, control technology is central to the firm's integrated water-engineering solutions, so management is likely to justify continued commitment by treating weaker signals as a temporary or packaging issue rather than product failure.

Flow measurement automation and system software strongly matches the firm's capabilities in automation and its future-oriented strategy, making it a product management would be inclined to continue backing after investing in development and launch.
